description: Source table sets for rebuilding NWVVASSalesTaxStatement in Fabric from temporary CSV extracts.

tables.name: TaxTrans
tables.notes: Primary posted tax fact source for the sales tax statement.

tables.name: NWVVASTaxStatementLineTaxCode
tables.notes: Custom setup bridge from TaxCode to VAS tax statement line/version/direction.

tables.name: NWVVASTaxStatementLine
tables.notes: Custom setup line table used to derive VATType.

tables.name: NWVVASTaxStatement
tables.notes: Custom tax statement version header.

tables.name: NWVVASParameters
tables.notes: Custom VAS parameter table for language, signatories, and VAT identity mode.

tables.name: LedgerJournalTrans
tables.notes: Fallback source when TaxTrans.TaxGroup is blank.

tables.name: CustInvoiceJour
tables.notes: Sales customer fallback for tax company name and tax registration number.

tables.name: CustTable
tables.notes: Customer fallback source for Party and VATNum.

tables.name: ProjInvoiceJour
tables.notes: Project invoice fallback when TaxTrans.Source is Project.

tables.name: TaxRegistration
tables.notes: VAT identity fallback when NWVVASParameters.VATByTaxRegistration is enabled.

tables.name: TaxRegistrationTypeApplicabilityRule
tables.notes: Tax registration applicability rule used by NWVUtility.

tables.name: TaxRegistrationLegislationTypes
tables.notes: Filters tax registration fallback to TAXID.

tables.name: DirPartyLocation
tables.notes: Links party to tax registration location.

tables.name: TaxVATNumTable
tables.notes: VAT identity fallback when VATByTaxRegistration is disabled.

tables.name: CompanyInfo
tables.notes: Header/legal entity source.

tables.name: LogisticsLocation
tables.notes: Header business location source.

tables.name: LogisticsLocationRole
tables.notes: Header business location role source.

tables.name: DirPartyPostalAddressView
tables.notes: Header address view used by NWVVASCompanyInfoTmp.

tables.name: Ledger
tables.notes: Accounting currency source.

tables.name: Currency
